title: Mixing: Helen Wheels by Wings | 1973
content:
Studio One, AIR Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Geoff Emerick

Wings’ first studio session following their trip to Lagos took place on 2 October 1973.

Although recorded during the Band On The Run sessions, their focus on this day was ‘Helen Wheels’, which Paul McCartney had earmarked for their next single. It was mixed during this session.

He chose ‘Country Dreamer’ for the b-side. It had been mixed at Abbey Road on 10 January 1973. Both songs were mastered the following day.
